title: ESCD / Dashboard Intake Must Resolve Existing vs New Before Response

any_of: DCS explicitly presents an item for ESCD
DCS explicitly presents an item for the dashboard
DCS directs that a task, knowledge item, artifact, idea, decision, risk, or follow-on be recorded in ESCD/dashboard

required_resolution: Classify the presented item by type, lane, entity, authority, sensitivity, and lifecycle.
Search the predetermined destination registry or registries for an existing matching record before creating anything.
If an existing record is found, update or link that record rather than creating a duplicate.
If no existing record is found, create the record immediately in the predetermined destination appropriate to its type.
Return the resolved state as EXISTING_UPDATED, EXISTING_LINKED, NEW_CREATED, or BLOCKED with evidence identifiers.

dashboard_item.purpose: ESCD/dashboard user-facing work and knowledge surface

project_task.purpose: durable substantive project task with Task ID, owner, status, validation, and closeout lifecycle

artifact.purpose: durable artifact/evidence pointer; may also surface in public.items as an Asset when useful

decision.purpose: material decision requiring durable decision history

ddna_knowledge.purpose: governed source/learning/retrieval state; surfaced to ESCD only when operationally useful

precedence: exact durable artifact or source key
same external evidence URL or GitHub issue/commit
semantic similarity requiring human-safe conservative match
duplicate_resolution.rule: When uncertain whether a semantically similar record is the same object, link/cross-reference and mark REVIEW rather than silently merge.

stop_gates: PS or protected information would cross into a non-PS dashboard surface
destination requires schema or permission change not already authorized
note: This candidate operationalizes the DCS directive that mentioning ESCD/dashboard is an instruction to resolve and persist the item, not merely discuss placement.
